review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent pre-candidate expectation. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 coherently require live, read-only wrapper counts from the existing internal limiter while preserving Promise, scheduling and clearQueue behavior. The complete supplied owner contents support the exact four-file binding scope: index.js, the directly maintained index.d.ts, test.js and index.test-d.ts. package.json is inspection evidence, not a required edit. Its xo && ava && tsd script and the supplied tool discovery/compiler evidence support separate runtime and non-executing type regressions. Stable requirement, acceptance and task keys agree across the PRD, original specification and Gold. Implementation and dependent independent verification must cover every required acceptance criterion. The sole project member is a non-auto-assignable reviewer without execution capability claims, supporting the earlier planning-review prerequisite but eligibility for neither execution task. Thus both explicit assignment abstentions, blocked readiness and evidence through assignments are coherent; no material unresolved business Decision is supplied. Historical project activity is not used as capability or candidate evidence. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct original/saved PRD, manifest/evaluation source and source/bundle digest domains. Repository, team, decision, model, sampling, policy and budget fingerprints are accepted as Service-bound inputs, not independently recomputed values. This review used only the supplied frozen data, executed no code and provides no human attestation. Approval concerns Gold coherence, not benchmark runnability or completion of the outstanding negative-control operations.
